definitions: A fictional character in Japanese folklore, a ninja who uses magic and is often depicted riding a giant toad.
A prominent character in the the manga and anime series 'Naruto', known as one of the Legendary Sannin and a mentor to Naruto Uzumaki.
examples: Jiraiya was a master of toad-related jutsu.
Many fans consider Jiraiya to be one of the most beloved characters in 'Naruto'.
